item.label: BOOK_06 §06.spectral Cubical coboundary operator as CAR creation operator satisfying d^2=0

record.section: 06.spectral Cubical coboundary operator as CAR creation operator satisfying d^2=0
record.notes: Construction of the cubical exterior coboundary d = sum_r (U_r - I) c_r†, proving nilpotency d^2 = 0 from the commutativity of translations and anticommutativity of CAR creation operators (archive_cubical_coboundary_owner).

scoped_attempts.scope: The literal-comparison countermodel only: canonicality, injectivity and golden word counts do not supply a Delta-equivalent same-object universal decoder or the first-source bound.
scoped_attempts.reopen_when: A pinned construction in actual D0 proves Pair(decoder_N,U_N(X_N)) is Delta-equivalent to Enc(X_N) on the same complete history, establishes an admitted injective decoder and a cost-capacity-matched competitive bound, and controls the same moving law/Fisher source. A changed interface needs a new typed question.

question.statement: Do the Book 01 canonicality definition, injectivity, and golden F/R word counts alone imply a same-object competitive decoder and the normalized complete-history code-minus-entropy first-source bound?
assumes: D_min=Can(Enc(X)) is minimal only within the actual Delta-equivalence class.
No Delta-equivalence between Pair(decoder_N,U_N(X_N)) and Enc(X_N) is assumed unless proved.
The physical code-cost unit and complete moving probability law are fixed by the native programme.

scoped_attempts.scope: Only the affine edge-price plus scalar positive Perron-pressure route as the entire Palatini action. This says nothing about nonlinear prices or the original complete H+J+R/CAR/memory/measurement/preparation/work/clock action.
scoped_attempts.reopen_when: A physically admitted non-affine field-to-edge price map or an independently derived additional same-history action term changes the exact action family; record that new interface and compare its full Hessian/source rather than relabeling this pressure-only route.

question.statement: Can the entire original 24-link Palatini quadratic action be derived from positive scalar Perron pressure after an affine map from the Lorentz coordinates to the original directed-edge prices?
assumes: The complete field-to-edge-price map is affine on the 24 independent original Lorentz directions.
The candidate action is only positive scalar Perron pressure; no additional Cost-Info, H+J+R, CAR/memory, measurement, preparation, clock or work terms contribute.
The same original 24-direction Palatini Hessian of inertia (12,12) is the target.

scoped_attempts.scope: The exact selected lower-order representative stated in the question; the nonzero fifth-order Ward projection rules out any fifth-amplitude correction for that representative.
scoped_attempts.reopen_when: Vary the remaining joint cubic/mixed-quartic or asymmetric-quartic homogeneous modes, change the finite carrier/action, or enlarge the physical question. Any such result needs its own pinned interface and must not be inferred from this selected-representative obstruction.

question.statement: Does the exact selected lower-order RREF representative of the perpendicular H=a*x, J=b*y branch at h=1 admit any fifth-amplitude extension, after allowing arbitrary fifth-degree corrections to the Lorentz links and coframe?
assumes: The original six-plaquette Lorentz-star action and its all-40 Euler variations are fixed.
The lower-order fields are exactly the mixed-quartic and asymmetric-quartic RREF representatives pinned by the cited checkers, with their remaining homogeneous modes set to zero.
The fifth-order Lorentz exponential includes all terms through degree five.

  Fintype.card D0.Geometry.CubicalCellType = 16 ∧
    (∀ (N : ℕ), D0.Geometry.CoboundaryNilpotent N) ∧
